=== Key insight ===
Our code: if (modules[row][col] !== null) continue;
Encoder code: if (_modules![row][col] != null) continue;
These should be equivalent...

=== Finder pattern extent ===
Our code loops from r=-1 to r=7, c=-1 to c=7
This means rows -1 to 7 = rows 0-7 (9 rows)

Top-left finder covers: rows 0-7, cols 0-7
But position 6 is INSIDE the finder separator area!

=== Checking (6, 6) alignment ===
Position (6, 6) should be skipped because finder pattern is already there
Row 6, col 6 is part of top-left finder separator
